name: Check One Check Two AI Video
blurb: One photo, and you lean into the lens in a night crowd and spit the JME check one check two verse.

prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo: keep this person exactly as photographed, same face, hair, skin tone and clothes. Vertical 9:16. First second: the photo as it is. Hard cut: the same person at night in the middle of a packed, dark crowd, filmed in a handheld phone close-up from the chest up, the crowd dim and out of focus behind them, a few small lights in the dark. They lean right into the lens and rap a fast UK grime verse straight to camera, opening with "yo, check one, check two", mouth moving clearly on every line, eyebrows up, head bobbing hard on the beat, one hand pointing at the lens. Slight camera shake, a quick white camera flash on the face halfway through, then they land the last line and stare into the lens, nodding. Real phone-footage look. Audio: a fast UK grime beat with their voice rapping the verse. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
